CHINA_ALPHA.notes: Strategic State Enterprise/Subsidiary with high Strategic Shielding Potential (SSP=0.90). Strategic firms are largely spared the effects of sanctions by government intervention. PCB represents 70% of total revenue (core product vulnerability). Lower export share to Western markets (30%) provides some diversification. Expected sanction loss (-10%) is smaller due to government shielding/bailouts. Located in Shanghai/YRD (coastal, rich prefecture) with high political centralization.

CHINA_BETA.notes: Privately Owned / Non-Strategic supplier with low Strategic Shielding Potential (SSP=0.20). Non-strategic firms are highly vulnerable to sanctions. PCB represents 30% of total revenue (lower core product concentration). High export share to Western markets (75%) creates significant vulnerability. Expected sanction loss (-35%) reflects potential loss of one-quarter of operating revenue and over one-half of asset value. Trade Diversion: Highly dependent firms suffer more if Western markets restrict trade. Located in inland/poor prefecture, requiring rail/truck transfer to coastal ports.

VIETNAM_GAMMA.notes: Privately Owned / Emerging supplier in Vietnam. Lower geopolitical risk due to alignment with Western bloc. PCB represents 40% of total revenue. High export share to Western markets (65%) but benefits from lower tariffs (0%) and geopolitical alignment. Expected sanction loss (-15%) is moderate. Benefits from capacity deterrence effects (0.60) as geopolitical rivalry leads to infrastructure investment in alternative suppliers. Located in Hai Phong (coastal), leveraging Vietnam's emerging manufacturing sector.
